title: CAD Draftsperson (Student)
apply_instructions: Email resume and cover letter to contact@arcivilconsultants.com.au with subject 'Application for CAD Draftsperson (Student)' (the careers section's Apply Now link).
rationale: Entry-level CAD drafting role that names a recently completed Advanced Diploma in Civil Construction Design, the exact qualification Marc finished in February 2026.

Duties (civil and architectural drawings in AutoCAD and/or Revit, revising drawings from engineer feedback) match his AutoCAD, Civil 3D and Revit coursework; the firm's infrastructure work includes road widening and drainage design.
Melbourne office on St Kilda Road, an easy commute by train from Melton; application by email to the address on the employer's own Apply Now link.
caution: Titled Student with flexible hours, so it may be part-time or a junior trainee rate; pay and hours are not stated. Small consultancy (est. 2019) whose site lists team roles as TBA; no posted or closing date is shown, so Marc may want to confirm it is still current. Architectural drawings and building permit work are part of the mix.
gaps: Drafting experience is academic, not commercial production drafting
No NCC or building permit documentation experience in facts
employer_line: AR Civil Consultancy has delivered civil drafting, design, building inspections and permit work since 2019, including road widening and drainage design for local infrastructure upgrades.
